scope: Ranks 1 through 100 in the current 2026 Fortune 500, revisited as the deepest AMACS architecture-validation cohort.
boundaries: Fortune rank and external industry labels establish research context only and do not prove a capability.
Market-role candidates are research classifications and are not production organization assertions.
A parent organization does not inherit a subsidiary or operating segment capability without explicit entity scope.
First-party sources may support taxonomy and architecture review but do not bypass production authority or verification requirements.
Outcome observations are separate from capability assertions and may influence future matching or standards only after governed aggregate-learning review.
No Fortune 100 research record may be imported directly into a production organization profile.
